title: Proportional Relationships as Lines Core Test
description: Connect proportional relationships to lines through the origin and equations of the form y = mx.

questions.questionText: A proportional relationship includes the point (2, 4) and the origin. Which equation represents its graph?
questions.explanation: A proportional relationship graphs as a line through the origin, and its equation has the form y = mx where m = y/x.
